row.notes: Samples rings around position param_2 (radius from 2.8, 16 angles of pi/8), quantises each sample to a 4-unit cell key, looks it up in the cell hash set (+0x58 seed, +0x60/+0x68 slots, +0x78 mask, +0x88/+0x8c) and returns ring radius - param_3 for the first occupied cell. Only caller Render_Apply_InstanceRenderProperties 0x14446c4a2. (lane owner review requested)
